[[File:Dathomir_amber.png|thumb|200px|A piece of Dathomir Amber]]
'''Amber''' was a [[Resin/Legends|resin]]-like substance found throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

[[Dathomir Amber]] was a rare substance found along the [[Water/Legends|watery]] portions of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] that was used to create jewelry,<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> [[Portaak amber]] could be extracted from [[Portaak leaf|Portaak leaves]] on the planet [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]],<ref name="Shatterpoint">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']] {{Ab|Shatterpoint (unabridged audiobook)}}</ref> and [[Manaxian amber]] was a substance found within the [[Manaxia system/Legends|Manaxia system]].<ref name="Roll of the Dice">{{InsiderCite|135|Roll of the Dice|reprint=1}}</ref> A [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Schnil Hakoon/Legends|Schnil Hakoon]], also owned a valuable [[Gemstone/Legends|jewel]] known as the [[Amber Eye]].<ref name="The Quality of Mercy">{{JournalCite|1|The Quality of Mercy}}</ref>

Various [[Plant/Legends|plants]] shared their name with the substance, including the [[Amber fern]]s<ref name="LotF">''[[Legacy of the Force: Sacrifice]]''</ref> and [[Amber-root]]s found on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]].<ref name="501st>''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref><ref name="LotF" /> The similarly [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]], [[Neimoidian amber]], could also be purchased on planets like [[Wielu]].<ref name="The Smuggler's Code">''[[The Clone Wars: The Smuggler's Code]]''</ref>
